baseline: First optimization pass, documented in 2026-10-28.jsonl; source snapshot at start of second pass.
method: Compiled ESM harness, sequential suites, five samples after at least 200 ms warmup. RPC 2000 iterations, serialization 1000, AddressBook 5000, scaling 100; scaling repeats 10000.

experiments.21-size-word: Reverted: standalone numeric size decoding did not help traversal.
experiments.22-array: Retained: allocate snapshot array once without Array.from initialization.
experiments.23-pointer-section: Retained: combine pointer field bounds and section resolution.
experiments.24-reuse-pointer: Refined in 25: pass primitive fields to shared validation helper.
experiments.25-text-read: Retained: internal text reader avoids Text wrapper.
experiments.26-scalar-section: Retained: combine scalar field bounds and section resolution.
experiments.27-text-near: Retained: decode near byte-list text directly with equivalent charges.
experiments.28-pack-runs: Refined in 29/35: bulk literal runs, word scan of zero runs.
experiments.29-pack-grow: Refined in 35: grow larger outputs, avoid proportional allocation for zero runs.
experiments.30-writev: Reverted: immediate cork/uncork did not consistently improve RPC.
experiments.31-list-target: Retained: private Symbol supplies raw target for internal wire access.
experiments.32-segment-arrays: Retained: avoid Array.from initialization for filled segment arrays.
experiments.34-final: Candidate; small dense packing regression refined in 35.
experiments.35-small-capacity: Retained: one initial allocation for inputs at most 2048 bytes; large inputs grow from 256 bytes.

caveats: Socket timings vary; close differences are not established wins.
100-iteration scaling measurements show JIT/GC transitions; use 10000-iteration repeats for short cases and packing.
No claim of reduced V8 heap allocation counts; native memory use is not measured.
